name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
steps: Add Greek yogurt to a bowl and stir in protein powder until smooth.
Slice the banana and add on top along with blueberries.
Sprinkle granola over the top and drizzle with honey.
Serve immediately.
tip: Mix the protein powder into the yogurt the night before for a thicker, creamier texture.

name: Egg White Omelette with Spinach & Feta
steps: Whisk egg whites with salt and pepper until frothy.
Spray a non-stick pan with olive oil and heat over medium.
Pour in egg whites and cook until edges set, about 3 minutes.
Add spinach, cherry tomatoes and feta to one half.
Fold omelette over the filling and cook 2 more minutes.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.
tip: Add a pinch of turmeric to the egg whites for anti-inflammatory benefits.

name: Overnight Oats with Cottage Cheese
steps: Combine oats, cottage cheese, milk and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir well, seal and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with sliced strawberries and maple syrup.
Eat cold or microwave for 90 seconds.
tip: Cottage cheese blends smooth if you blend it first — kids and picky eaters won't notice.

name: Smoked Salmon & Avocado Eggs
steps: Poach or scramble eggs to your liking.
Slice avocado and season with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Arrange smoked salmon, eggs and avocado on a plate.
Top with capers and serve with rye crispbread.
tip: Omega-3 from salmon + healthy fats from avocado = optimal hormone balance for training days.

name: Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend oats, cottage cheese, eggs, protein powder, baking powder and vanilla until smooth.
Heat coconut oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour batter into 4 pancakes and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with fresh berries or a drizzle of honey.
tip: Rest the batter 2 minutes before cooking — it thickens and makes fluffier pancakes.

name: Turkey & Spinach Scrambled Eggs
steps: Cook ground turkey in a pan until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add garlic and spinach and cook 1 minute until wilted.
Whisk whole eggs and egg whites together.
Pour eggs over the turkey mixture and scramble on low heat until just set.
Season and serve immediately.
tip: Cook eggs on low heat — slower = creamier scrambled eggs every time.

name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil baby potatoes 10 minutes until tender, then cool.
Blanch green beans 2 minutes and rinse cold.
Halve boiled eggs.
Arrange leaves, potatoes, green beans, tuna and eggs on a plate.
Scatter olives and drizzle with dressing.
tip: Use tuna in spring water, not oil — saves 80 calories with identical protein.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Power Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa in 160ml water for 15 minutes, then fluff.
Season chicken with salt and pepper, grill or pan-fry 6 minutes per side.
Slice chicken and assemble bowl with quinoa, edamame, cucumber and cabbage.
Mix tahini, lemon juice and soy sauce with 1 tbsp water for dressing.
Drizzle over bowl and serve.
tip: Quinoa is a complete protein — it has all 9 essential amino acids, unlike rice.

name: Ground Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook turkey in a pan over medium-high heat until browned.
Add garlic, ginger, water chestnuts and carrots, cook 3 minutes.
Stir in hoisin sauce and sesame oil.
Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves and serve immediately.
tip: Swap hoisin for tamari and this becomes fully gluten-free without losing any flavour.

name: Lentil & Chicken Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in a pot 5 minutes.
Add cumin and turmeric, stir 1 minute.
Add lentils, chicken and stock. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes until lentils are soft.
Remove chicken, shred it, return to pot and serve.
tip: Lentils don't need soaking — rinse and cook straight from dry for this soup.

name: Salmon & Brown Rice Bowl
steps: Cook brown rice according to package (about 25 min).
Steam broccoli 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pan-fry salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Assemble bowl with rice, broccoli and salmon.
Drizzle with soy sauce and lime, top with sesame seeds and spring onions.
tip: Don't move the salmon once it hits the pan — let the skin crisp fully before flipping.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Season chicken and grill 6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Slice chicken and let cool slightly.
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing and lemon juice.
Layer chicken, dressed lettuce and Parmesan on the wrap.
Roll tightly, cut in half and serve.
tip: Toast the wrap in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side for extra texture.

name: Baked Cod with Roasted Veg
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss veg with olive oil, garlic powder and paprika on a tray.
Roast veg 15 minutes.
Season cod and place on top of the veg.
Squeeze lemon over everything and roast 12 more minutes.
Serve directly from the tray.
tip: Cod is done when it flakes easily with a fork — avoid overcooking or it turns rubbery.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry
steps: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornstarch for the sauce.
Heat wok over high heat, add sesame oil.
Stir-fry beef 2 minutes until browned, remove.
Add garlic and broccoli, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Return beef to wok, pour sauce over, toss 1 minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.
tip: Freeze the beef for 20 minutes before slicing — it firms up and makes thin slicing much easier.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Mix turkey, egg, oregano and Parmesan, form into 12 meatballs.
Pan-fry meatballs in olive oil 8 minutes turning occasionally.
Add passata and garlic, simmer 10 minutes.
Meanwhile salt zucchini noodles and microwave 2 minutes or sauté 2 minutes.
Serve meatballs and sauce over zucchini noodles.
tip: Salting zucchini noodles and patting dry stops the dish going watery.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala (High Protein)
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and 1 tbsp tikka paste for 10 minutes.
Cook rice according to package.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger 5 minutes.
Add remaining paste, cook 1 minute.
Add marinated chicken and cook 8 minutes.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over basmati rice.
tip: Using Greek yogurt instead of cream triples the protein while keeping the dish creamy.

name: Grilled Steak with Sweet Potato
steps: Bake sweet potato at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Grill steak on high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest steak 5 minutes, then top with garlic butter.
Grill asparagus 4 minutes alongside.
Serve steak sliced with sweet potato and asparagus.
tip: Always rest your steak — cutting too early loses all the juices onto the board.

name: Shrimp & Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat wok on high, add oil and stir-fry shrimp 2 minutes.
Push to the side, scramble eggs in the centre.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add peas and corn, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together 2 minutes.
Garnish with spring onions and serve.
tip: Day-old cold rice is essential — fresh rice is too wet and makes it stodgy.

name: Cottage Cheese & Fruit Snack Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple chunks.
Dust with cinnamon and serve.
tip: Pineapple contains bromelain which aids protein digestion — great post-workout combo.

name: Hard Boiled Eggs with Hummus
steps: Boil eggs 10 minutes for hard boiled, cool in cold water and peel.
Slice eggs in half and dust with paprika.
Serve alongside hummus and celery sticks.
tip: Add a teaspoon of baking soda to boiling water — eggs peel much more easily.

name: Protein Smoothie (Chocolate Peanut Butter)
steps: Add all ingredients to blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
tip: Freeze the banana in chunks first — it makes the smoothie much thicker without needing extra ice.

name: Tuna Rice Cakes
steps: Mix tuna with Greek yogurt, lemon juice and chives.
Spoon onto rice cakes and serve immediately.
tip: Greek yogurt in tuna keeps it creamy with a protein boost — skip the mayo entirely.

name: Edamame with Sea Salt
steps: Microwave edamame with 2 tbsp water for 4–5 minutes.
Drain and toss with sea salt flakes.
Serve warm in the shell.
tip: Edamame is one of the few plant foods that is a complete protein source.

name: Beef & Black Bean Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef, drain fat, add taco seasoning and cook 2 minutes.
Add black beans and warm through.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds each side.
Mash avocado with lime juice.
Fill tortillas with beef mixture, avocado and a dollop of Greek yogurt.
Top with coriander and a squeeze of lime.
tip: Greek yogurt works as a sour cream replacement — more protein, fewer calories, same tang.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Green Beans
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Rub chicken with olive oil, garlic and herbs.
Place in a baking dish with lemon slices.
Bake 20 minutes, then add green beans around the chicken.
Bake 10 more minutes until chicken is golden and cooked through.
tip: Chicken thighs stay juicier than breast at high heat — great for batch cooking.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Bites
steps: Mix all ingredients together until a dough forms.
Roll into 10 balls.
Refrigerate 30 minutes to firm up.
Store in fridge up to 5 days.
tip: If the mixture is too wet, add more oats 1 tbsp at a time until it holds its shape.

name: Tofu Scramble with Peppers
steps: Crumble tofu with your hands into small pieces.
Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil 4 minutes.
Add tofu, turmeric and nutritional yeast, stir-fry 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, toss and serve immediately.
tip: Press tofu for 15 minutes before cooking to remove water — it gets much crispier.

name: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix salmon, egg, breadcrumbs, mustard, lemon zest and spring onions.
Form into 4 patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil 4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with a green salad or in a wrap.
tip: Refrigerate the patties 15 minutes before frying — they hold together better.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Cook rice according to package.
Sauté onion and garlic 5 minutes.
Add garam masala, cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk.
Simmer 20 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice.
tip: A can of chickpeas has 20g protein — rinse them well to reduce sodium by 40%.

name: Baked Egg Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C. Spray a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, season well.
Divide turkey, tomatoes and cheese into muffin holes.
Pour egg mixture over each.
Bake 18 minutes until set and golden.
Cool slightly and pop out with a knife.
tip: Make a batch on Sunday — these keep in the fridge 4 days and are perfect grab-and-go snacks.

name: High Protein Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk protein powder into almond milk until dissolved.
Add chia seeds, stir well.
Cover and refrigerate minimum 4 hours or overnight.
Stir again before serving, top with mango and coconut.
tip: Stir once after 30 minutes in the fridge to prevent clumping.

name: White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil 4 minutes.
Add beans, stock and rosemary.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add kale and cook 3 more minutes.
Season and serve with crusty bread if desired.
tip: Blend a third of the soup and stir back in for a creamy texture without adding cream.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice per package instructions.
Steam broccoli 4 minutes.
Pan-fry chicken 6 minutes per side, glaze with teriyaki sauce last 2 minutes.
Slice chicken and serve over rice with broccoli.
Top with sesame seeds and sliced spring onions.
tip: Add sauce only at the end — it burns quickly and turns bitter if added too early.

name: Greek Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix lamb, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic, mint and cumin.
Form into 12 meatballs.
Pan-fry or bake at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until cooked through.
Warm pitta bread, fill with meatballs and tzatziki.
Serve with a fresh tomato and cucumber salad.
tip: Lamb has more zinc and B12 than chicken — excellent for muscle recovery.

name: Seared Tuna Steak with Edamame
steps: Marinate tuna in soy sauce, sesame oil and ginger 5 minutes.
Heat a pan to very high heat.
Sear tuna 90 seconds per side — keep rare in the centre.
Microwave edamame with water 3 minutes.
Slice tuna, serve with edamame and lime.
tip: Tuna should be seared hot and fast — overcooking makes it dry and mealy.

name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Smoked Salmon
steps: Toast sourdough until golden.
Spread cottage cheese generously on each slice.
Top with smoked salmon.
Add capers, dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve immediately.
tip: Cottage cheese on toast is trending for good reason — 14g protein per 100g vs 2g for cream cheese.

name: Beef Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Brown beef with onion, drain fat.
Mix beef with rice, crushed tomatoes and seasoning.
Fill pepper halves with the mixture.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake 30–35 minutes until peppers are tender and cheese golden.
tip: Parboil peppers 3 minutes before filling to ensure they cook through evenly.

name: Protein Oatmeal with Almonds
steps: Cook oats in almond milk over medium heat 4–5 minutes, stirring.
Remove from heat and stir in protein powder.
Top with banana, almonds and cinnamon.
tip: Stir protein powder in off the heat — cooking it makes it grainy.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon
steps: Mix miso, mirin and soy sauce.
Spread glaze on salmon.
Broil salmon 10–12 minutes until caramelised on top.
Steam bok choy 3 minutes.
Serve salmon with bok choy and sesame seeds.
tip: Miso is fermented — it adds a deep umami flavour and gut-friendly probiotics.

name: Egg & Avocado Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble eggs in a non-stick pan until just set.
Mash avocado with salt and pepper.
Spread avocado on wrap, add spinach and eggs.
Drizzle with hot sauce, roll and eat.
tip: Undercook the eggs slightly — they continue cooking from the wrap's warmth.

name: Spicy Chicken Lettuce Cups
steps: Cook chicken with soy sauce and sriracha until cooked through.
Fill lettuce cups with chicken and cucumber.
Squeeze lime over the top and serve.
tip: Butter lettuce cups hold their shape better than regular lettuce for wraps.

name: Blackened Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Coat chicken in blackening spice.
Sear chicken 6 minutes per side in a very hot pan until charred.
Sauté cauliflower rice with garlic and olive oil 4 minutes.
Rest chicken 3 minutes, slice and serve over cauliflower rice.
Finish with a squeeze of lime.
tip: Open a window — blackening spice smokes a lot. High heat is essential for the crust.

name: Steak & Egg Power Breakfast
steps: Season steak with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot pan 2–3 minutes per side.
Rest steak 3 minutes.
In the same pan, fry eggs in butter to your liking.
Slice steak and serve with eggs and parsley.
tip: The steak resting juices mixed with butter makes a perfect pan sauce — spoon it over.

name: Pea & Mint Protein Frittata
steps: Preheat grill/broiler.
Whisk eggs, mix in peas, mint, feta and spring onions.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan.
Pour in egg mixture, cook 5 minutes on stovetop.
Transfer to grill for 5 minutes until set and golden on top.
Slice and serve.
tip: A frittata keeps in the fridge 3 days — great for meal prep.

name: Pulled Chicken Sweet Potato Bowl
steps: Roast sweet potato at 200°C with smoked paprika 25 minutes.
Simmer chicken in stock 20 minutes until cooked through.
Shred chicken with two forks and mix with BBQ sauce.
Mix coleslaw with Greek yogurt.
Assemble bowl: sweet potato, pulled chicken, coleslaw.
tip: Use Greek yogurt coleslaw dressing for 10g extra protein per serving over mayo.

name: Prawn Stir Fry with Noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles in boiling water 5 minutes, drain.
Stir-fry garlic and veg on high heat 3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Add noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and chilli.
Toss everything 1 minute and serve hot.
tip: Prawns cook in 3 minutes — they turn rubbery if overdone. Pink and curled = done.

name: Ricotta Stuffed Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix ricotta, spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic and herbs.
Butterfly each chicken breast (cut almost through to open flat).
Fill with ricotta mixture and seal with toothpicks.
Sear in oven-safe pan 2 minutes per side.
Transfer to oven and bake 18–20 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
tip: Use toothpicks to secure the filling — remove them before serving.

name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients in a mug until smooth.
Microwave on high 60–75 seconds.
Allow to cool 1 minute before eating.
Top with a spoon of peanut butter if desired.
tip: Don't overcook — it should be slightly gooey in the centre.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, olive oil and herbs 5 minutes.
Grill chicken 6 minutes per side.
Slice chicken and let rest.
Toss all vegetables together.
Top salad with chicken slices and remaining dressing.
tip: Grill in batches of 2–3 to keep the pan hot — this gives a better sear.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Veg
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Toss veg with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Mix honey, mustard and thyme and coat pork.
Roast pork and veg together 25–30 minutes.
Rest pork 5 minutes before slicing.
tip: Pork tenderloin is the leanest cut — as lean as chicken breast with more iron.

name: Edamame & Black Bean Burrito Bowl
steps: Cook brown rice per package.
Warm black beans in a pan with cumin and salt.
Microwave edamame 2 minutes.
Assemble bowl: rice, beans, edamame, corn, salsa and guacamole.
Squeeze lime over everything.
tip: This bowl reheats perfectly — make double the rice for next day's lunch.

name: Grilled Turkey Burger
steps: Mix turkey with egg white and garlic powder.
Form a patty.
Grill 6 minutes per side until internal temp is 74°C.
Serve on whole wheat bun with lettuce, tomato and mustard.
tip: Turkey burgers dry out easily — don't press down on the patty while cooking.

name: Chocolate Banana Protein Ice Cream
steps: Blend all ingredients until completely smooth.
Eat soft-serve style immediately or freeze 20 minutes for firmer texture.
tip: Use a very ripe frozen banana — the riper it is, the sweeter and creamier the result.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring stock and soy sauce to a boil.
Dissolve cornstarch in 1 tbsp cold water and stir into soup.
Slowly pour in whisked eggs while stirring in circles.
Remove from heat, drizzle sesame oil, top with spring onion.
tip: Pour eggs in a very thin stream — this creates those signature silky ribbons.

name: Chickpea Protein Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Blend all ingredients except chocolate chips until smooth.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into lined baking tin.
Bake 20–22 minutes until set.
Cool completely before cutting into 6 squares.
tip: Refrigerate overnight — they become fudgier and much better the next day.

name: Asian Beef Noodle Bowl
steps: Cook soba noodles, rinse and set aside.
Sear beef slices in a hot pan 2 minutes total.
Heat broth with soy sauce and chilli oil.
Blanch bok choy in broth 1 minute.
Assemble bowl: noodles, beef, bok choy, broth.
Top with soft boiled egg and spring onions.
tip: For a perfect soft boiled egg: boil 7 minutes exactly, then ice bath immediately.

name: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Peppers
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Sauté garlic and spinach until wilted.
Mix spinach with quinoa and crumbled feta.
Fill pepper halves and bake 25 minutes.
Serve hot.
tip: Add a sprinkle of pine nuts for healthy fats and extra crunch.

name: Protein Waffles
steps: Blend oats to a fine flour.
Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Heat waffle iron and spray with oil.
Pour in batter and cook 4–5 minutes per waffle.
Serve with berries and a drizzle of honey.
tip: Let batter rest 2 minutes — this allows the oat flour to hydrate for better texture.

name: Shrimp Avocado Salad
steps: Dice avocado and toss with lime juice.
Arrange leaves, cucumber, avocado and shrimp.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle chilli flakes.
Serve immediately.
tip: Tossing avocado in lime juice prevents browning — it keeps fresh for hours.

name: Baked Falafel with Tzatziki
steps: Blend soaked chickpeas, garlic, cumin, coriander and parsley to a rough paste.
Form into 12 small balls.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve warm with tzatziki.
tip: Use dried soaked chickpeas, not canned — canned are too wet and fall apart.

name: Spiced Lamb Kofta
steps: Mix lamb with onion, garlic and spices.
Shape into 8 oval koftas around skewers.
Grill or pan-fry 10–12 minutes turning often.
Serve in warm pitta with yogurt dip and leaves.
tip: Squeeze excess moisture from the grated onion — this stops the koftas falling off the skewers.

name: Smoked Turkey & Avocado Club
steps: Toast bread until golden.
Spread mustard on one slice and mashed avocado on the other.
Layer turkey, spinach and tomato.
Close sandwich, cut diagonally and serve.
tip: Mashing avocado instead of slicing keeps it from sliding out of the sandwich.

name: Overnight Protein Chia Oats
steps: Combine oats, chia, protein and milk in a jar.
Stir, seal and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with raspberries.
Add extra milk if too thick.
tip: Raspberries are one of the highest-fiber fruits — 8g per 100g. Perfect for fat loss.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring stock to a boil with chicken, thyme and bay leaves.
Simmer 20 minutes, remove chicken and shred.
Add vegetables to the stock.
Simmer 10 more minutes until tender.
Return chicken and serve hot.
tip: Skim foam from the surface in the first 5 minutes for a clearer, better-tasting broth.

name: Sardine & Tomato Toast
steps: Toast rye bread.
Mash sardines with lemon juice and chilli.
Spread sardine mix on toast and top with tomato slices.
tip: Sardines are one of the richest sources of omega-3 and calcium — massively underrated.

name: Honey Sriracha Salmon
steps: Mix honey, sriracha and soy sauce.
Coat salmon in glaze.
Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes.
Serve over jasmine rice with steamed broccoli.
tip: The honey caramelises under heat — watch closely in the last 2 minutes to avoid burning.

name: Whey Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen berries, banana, protein and yogurt with a little milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl — it should be thick enough to hold toppings.
Top with granola and a few fresh berries.
tip: Use very little liquid — a smoothie bowl should be scoopable, not drinkable.

name: Baked Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C. Remove mushroom stems.
Mix ricotta, wilted spinach, sun-dried tomatoes and garlic.
Fill mushroom caps and top with Parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until golden.
tip: Place mushrooms on a rack so water drains — stuffed mushrooms on a flat tray go watery.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season chicken with garlic powder and sear 6 minutes each side.
Slice chicken and allow to rest.
Toss romaine with dressing and lemon juice.
Top with chicken and Parmesan shavings.
tip: For extra crunch without croutons, add a handful of toasted pumpkin seeds.

name: Protein Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C. Line a loaf tin.
Mix all ingredients until just combined.
Pour into tin and bake 38–40 minutes.
Test with a skewer — it should come out clean.
Cool completely before slicing.
tip: The riper the bananas the sweeter and more moist the loaf — use black ones.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
steps: Coat chicken in shawarma spice and olive oil.
Cook in a hot pan 8 minutes per side.
Slice chicken and assemble bowl with rice, hummus and salad.
Dollop Greek yogurt mixed with lemon juice on top.
tip: Chicken thighs absorb spices better than breast — don't substitute here.

name: Skyr with Seeds & Berries
steps: Spoon skyr into a bowl.
Top with seeds, blueberries and a drizzle of honey.
tip: Skyr has slightly more protein than Greek yogurt per gram — worth switching if you can find it.

name: Korean Bibimbap Bowl
steps: Cook beef with garlic and soy sauce until done.
Sauté each vegetable separately with sesame oil.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Assemble bowls: rice in centre, toppings in sections.
Top with a fried egg and gochujang.
Mix everything together before eating.
tip: The mixing is part of the dish — everything should be stirred together with the gochujang.

name: Vegan Protein Bowl
steps: Roast sweet potato at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Massage kale with a little olive oil until softened.
Assemble bowl: rice, lentils, sweet potato, kale.
Blend tahini, lemon and garlic with water for dressing.
Drizzle over bowl.
tip: Massaging kale for 1 minute with oil completely transforms its texture — much more tender.

name: Bacon & Egg Protein Wrap
steps: Grill bacon until crispy.
Scramble whole eggs and egg whites together.
Layer bacon, scrambled eggs and cheese on the wrap.
Add hot sauce, roll tightly and eat hot.
tip: Lean back bacon has 60% less fat than streaky bacon with the same protein.

name: Crispy Tofu Buddha Bowl
steps: Press tofu dry and cut into cubes.
Toss tofu with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until crispy.
Assemble bowl with rice, tofu, edamame, cucumber and carrot.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve.
tip: Baking tofu gives it a much better texture than frying — no oil splatter either.

name: Beef Protein Burger (No Bun)
steps: Form beef into a patty, season well.
Cook in a hot pan 4–5 minutes per side.
Use lettuce leaves as a bun.
Fill with burger, tomato, onion and mustard.
tip: 5% fat beef makes an incredibly lean burger — season generously to compensate.

name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oats and vanilla until smooth.
Heat coconut oil in a non-stick pan.
Cook small pancakes 2 minutes per side.
Serve with fresh berries.
tip: Keep pancakes small — 8cm diameter — they flip much more easily than large ones.

name: Tuna Stuffed Avocado
steps: Halve the avocado and remove the stone.
Mix tuna, red onion, Greek yogurt and lemon juice.
Spoon filling into each avocado half.
Top with chilli flakes and serve.
tip: Eat immediately — avocado browns quickly once cut.

name: Black Bean Protein Quesadilla
steps: Mash black beans with cumin.
Spread on one tortilla, top with cheese and second tortilla.
Cook in dry pan 3 min per side until golden.
Cut into quarters, serve with yogurt and salsa.
tip: Press lightly with a spatula while cooking — even contact makes it crispier.

name: Poached Eggs on Sweet Potato Toast
steps: Toast sweet potato slices in a toaster twice until tender.
Bring water to a simmer, add a splash of vinegar.
Swirl and poach eggs 3 minutes.
Top sweet potato with spinach and poached eggs.
Season and serve.
tip: Slice sweet potato no thicker than 1cm so it fits in a standard toaster.

name: Grilled Halloumi Salad
steps: Grill halloumi slices 2–3 min per side until golden.
Arrange leaves, watermelon and mint.
Top with halloumi.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon.
tip: Dry halloumi with a paper towel before grilling — it gets a much better crust.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint Yogurt
steps: Marinate lamb with garlic, rosemary, lemon and salt 5 min.
Grill on high heat 3–4 min per side for medium.
Blend yogurt, mint and lemon for sauce.
Serve chops with mint yogurt.
tip: Lamb chops are quick — high heat, short time. Don't overcook or they toughen fast.

name: Smoked Mackerel Pâté on Crispbread
steps: Flake mackerel and blend with cream cheese, lemon and horseradish.
Season to taste.
Spread on crispbread and serve.
tip: Mackerel is one of the highest omega-3 fish — great for reducing inflammation after training.

name: Spicy Prawn Tacos
steps: Toss prawns with chipotle paste and cook 3 min per side.
Mix yogurt with lime juice for sauce.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with prawns, cabbage and sauce.
Top with coriander.
tip: Chipotle paste keeps for months in the fridge — start with less, it's very smoky.

name: Pea & Ham Frittata
steps: Preheat grill/broiler.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté ham and spring onions 2 min.
Add peas, pour in eggs.
Cook stovetop 5 min, then grill 5 min until set.
Crumble feta on top before serving.
tip: A frittata is one of the best meal-prep breakfasts — 4 servings in under 20 minutes.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, protein, peanut butter, cocoa and milk in a jar.
Stir well, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with banana slices in the morning.
tip: This keeps well for 3 days — make a batch of 3 jars on Sunday.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables with fajita seasoning 10–12 min.
Serve over brown rice.
Top with Greek yogurt and lime juice.
tip: Slice chicken against the grain for tenderness — makes a big difference.

name: Protein Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer rice in milk over low heat 15 min, stirring often.
Remove from heat, stir in protein powder and honey.
Top with raisins and cinnamon.
Serve warm or cold.
tip: Stir protein in off the heat — cooking denatures it and turns it gritty.

name: Egg White French Toast
steps: Whisk egg whites, cinnamon, vanilla and milk.
Soak bread slices 1 min each side.
Cook in a non-stick pan 3 min per side until golden.
Serve with fresh berries.
tip: Egg white French toast has the same texture as regular but with zero fat from yolks.

name: Spiced Turkey Mince Bowl
steps: Sauté onion 3 min, add turkey and cook until brown.
Add spices, cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes and simmer 8 min.
Serve over cauliflower rice.
tip: Cauliflower rice microwaved with a little butter for 3 minutes is near-identical to the real thing.

name: Mixed Nut & Dark Chocolate Protein Bark
steps: Melt chocolate with coconut oil.
Stir in protein powder until smooth.
Pour onto lined baking sheet.
Scatter nuts and sea salt.
Refrigerate 1 hour until set.
Break into pieces.
tip: 85% dark chocolate has minimal sugar — don't go lower or it won't set properly.

name: Chicken Zucchini Pasta
steps: Cook chicken in olive oil 6 min per side, slice.
Sauté garlic 1 min, add tomatoes and cook 3 min.
Add zucchini noodles and toss 2 min.
Top with chicken, basil and Parmesan.
tip: Zucchini noodles release water fast — add them last and serve immediately.

name: Egg & Bean Breakfast Burrito
steps: Scramble eggs with cumin.
Warm beans in pan.
Fill tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese and salsa.
Roll tightly and eat hot.
tip: Warm the tortilla 20 seconds in the microwave — cold tortillas crack when rolling.

name: Tuna & Corn Protein Pasta
steps: Cook pasta per package.
Mix tuna, corn, yogurt, lemon and parsley.
Drain pasta, toss with tuna mixture.
Season and serve warm or cold.
tip: This works great as a cold pasta salad — make extra for tomorrow's lunch.

name: Venison Steak with Roasted Beetroot
steps: Roast beetroot with thyme and olive oil at 200°C for 30 min.
Season venison with salt and pepper.
Sear 2 min per side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 min.
Serve sliced over watercress with beetroot and goats cheese.
Drizzle balsamic over top.
tip: Venison is the leanest red meat available — lower fat than chicken breast with more iron.

name: Greek Protein Salad
steps: Combine all vegetables in a bowl.
Crumble feta over top.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle oregano.
Toss gently and serve.
tip: Add a can of chickpeas to boost protein to 35g and make it a full meal.

name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
steps: Coat chicken in tikka paste.
Grill 6 min per side until cooked.
Slice chicken.
Spread yogurt on wrap, add spinach and cucumber.
Fill with chicken, drizzle with lemon, roll.
tip: Leftover chicken tikka is even better the next day — make extra at dinner.

name: Spiced Lentil Dahl
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger 4 min.
Add spices, cook 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer 20 min until thick.
Season and serve with rice or naan.
tip: Dahl freezes perfectly in portions — make a big batch and freeze for the week.

name: High Protein Overnight Porridge
steps: Mix oats, protein, milk, apple, cinnamon and flaxseeds.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Eat cold or heat 1 minute in microwave.
tip: Casein absorbs overnight better than whey — it makes a much creamier texture in oats.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Add eggs and stir gently with a spatula, folding continuously.
Add spinach when eggs are almost set and stir until wilted.
Remove from heat while still slightly glossy and serve immediately.
tip: Low heat and constant stirring gives you the creamiest scrambled eggs — never rush them.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil 5 minutes.
Add cumin and paprika, stir 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Serve directly from the pan with crusty bread.
tip: Cover the pan tightly — steam cooks the egg whites from above, keeping yolks runny.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat wok or large pan on very high heat with oil.
Add garlic and stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Push rice to the side and scramble eggs in the centre.
Mix eggs into rice, add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together, top with spring onions and serve.
tip: Day-old cold rice is essential — fresh rice makes the dish clumpy and soggy.

name: Spanish Tortilla
steps: Cook potato and onion in olive oil on low heat 12 minutes until tender.
Drain, reserving 1 tbsp oil. Season with salt.
Whisk eggs and fold in the potato mixture.
Heat reserved oil in the pan, pour in the egg mixture.
Cook 5 minutes until edges set, then flip onto a plate and slide back into pan.
Cook 3 more minutes, slide onto a plate and serve warm or at room temperature.
tip: The classic Spanish tortilla is meant to be served at room temperature — it tastes better than hot.

name: Simple Egg Curry
steps: Hard-boil eggs 10 minutes, peel and set aside.
Sauté onion in coconut oil 5 minutes until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and spices, cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes.
Score eggs and add to the sauce.
Simmer 3 more minutes and serve with rice.
tip: Score the hard-boiled eggs before adding to the sauce so they absorb the flavours.

name: Poached Eggs on Toast
steps: Toast bread to your liking.
Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer, add vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small cup first.
Create a gentle swirl in the water and slide egg in.
Poach 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
Lift out with a slotted spoon, drain and place on toast.
Season with salt, pepper and chilli flakes.
tip: Cracking eggs into a cup first lets you check for broken yolks before adding to the water.

name: Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan, sauté garlic 1 minute.
Add passata and oregano, simmer 5 minutes.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each.
Transfer to oven and bake 8 minutes until whites are just set.
Serve immediately with crusty bread.
tip: Pull the pan from the oven when whites look barely set — they keep cooking in the hot sauce.

name: Classic French Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs thoroughly with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat until foamy.
Pour in eggs and immediately stir in small circles with a spatula.
When curds form but eggs are still slightly liquid, stop stirring.
Shake pan to even out the omelette and fold one third over.
Roll out onto plate seam-side down. It should be pale yellow, not browned.
tip: A French omelette should take under 2 minutes to cook — high heat, fast hands.

name: Egg & Veg Stir Fry
steps: Whisk eggs and season lightly.
Heat wok on high with sesame oil, stir-fry vegetables 4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Push veg to sides and scramble eggs in the centre.
Mix everything together, add soy sauce and toss.
Serve immediately.
tip: Cook veg first on high heat so they stay crisp, then add eggs last.

name: Simple Grilled Chicken
steps: Pound chicken to even thickness for faster cooking.
Rub with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-sear 6 to 7 minutes per side over medium-high heat.
Rest 3 minutes before slicing.
Squeeze lemon over and serve.
tip: Pounding the chicken to even thickness ensures it cooks through without dry edges.

name: Quick Beef Stir Fry
steps: Mix soy sauce and oyster sauce together.
Heat wok on very high heat with vegetable oil.
Stir-fry beef 2 minutes until browned, remove from pan.
Add garlic and vegetables, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Return beef, pour over sauce and toss everything.
Drizzle sesame oil and serve immediately.
tip: High heat is essential for stir-fry — a hot wok gives you charred flavour, not steamed veg.

name: Pan-Seared Salmon
steps: Pat salmon dry and season generously.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side down and cook without moving for 5 minutes.
Flip and add garlic, cook 3 more minutes.
Squeeze lemon over and garnish with dill.
Serve immediately.
tip: Resist moving the salmon — letting the skin render fully means it releases cleanly.

name: Tuna Salad
steps: Arrange salad leaves on a plate.
Top with tomatoes, cucumber and red onion.
Flake tuna over the top.
Whisk lemon juice and olive oil for dressing.
Drizzle over salad and serve.
tip: Tuna in spring water has no added fat and 26g protein per 100g — one of the best value proteins.

name: Simple Turkey Bowl
steps: Brown ground turkey in olive oil with garlic powder until cooked through.
Steam broccoli 4 minutes.
Assemble bowl: rice, turkey, broccoli.
Drizzle soy sauce over everything and serve.
tip: Ground turkey is one of the leanest proteins available — ideal for fat loss phases.

name: Pork & Veg Bowl
steps: Season pork with salt and pepper.
Sear pork in a hot pan 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Remove and rest. In same pan cook garlic and ginger 1 minute.
Add bok choy, soy sauce and sesame oil, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Slice pork and serve over rice with bok choy.
tip: Pork loin cooks fast — slice thin to avoid overcooking and keep it juicy.

name: Shrimp Garlic Butter
steps: Pat shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink and curled.
Squeeze lemon over and garnish with parsley.
Serve immediately.
tip: Shrimp are done the moment they turn pink and curl into a C-shape — overcooked shrimp curl tight.

name: Simple Tofu Bowl
steps: Press tofu dry, cut into cubes.
Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and garlic powder.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
Microwave edamame 2 minutes.
Assemble bowl with rice, tofu and edamame.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve.
tip: Pressing tofu removes water and lets it get crispy in the oven — a paper towel and heavy pan works.

name: Lentil Dal
steps: Sauté onion in coconut oil 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric and cumin, cook 2 minutes.
Rinse lentils and add with stock.
Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 18 minutes until thick.
Season and serve with rice or flatbread.
tip: Dal naturally thickens as it cools — add a splash of water when reheating leftovers.

name: Chickpea Stew
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil 5 minutes.
Add paprika and stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas, simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Season and serve with crusty bread.
tip: Chickpeas absorb flavours well — this stew is always better the next day.

name: Black Bean Bowl
steps: Warm black beans with cumin and a pinch of salt in a small pan.
Assemble bowl: rice, beans, corn and avocado.
Squeeze lime over the top.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve.
tip: Rinsing canned black beans reduces sodium by about 40% without losing protein.

name: Peanut Butter Oats
steps: Cook oats in almond milk over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in peanut butter and honey.
Top with banana slices and cinnamon.
Serve immediately.
tip: Natural peanut butter has only 2 ingredients — avoid brands with added sugar and palm oil.

name: Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Heat wok on very high heat with a splash of oil.
Add hardest vegetables first — carrot and broccoli — stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add pepper, snap peas and edamame, stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Add garlic and stir 30 seconds.
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil, toss and serve.
tip: Add vegetables in order of hardness so everything finishes cooking at the same time.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Add half the berries and granola.
Repeat the layers.
Drizzle honey over the top and serve.
tip: Layer from the bottom up so each spoonful has yogurt, berries and crunch together.

name: Protein Oats
steps: Cook oats in milk over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes, stirring.
Remove from heat and stir in protein powder.
Top with sliced banana and cinnamon.
Eat immediately.
tip: Always add protein powder off the heat — cooking it destroys the texture and turns it grainy.

name: Simple Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced strawberries.
Drizzle honey and add a pinch of black pepper.
Serve immediately.
tip: A pinch of black pepper on cottage cheese with fruit is a surprisingly good flavour pairing.

name: Quick Protein Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 30 to 45 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
tip: A frozen banana replaces ice and makes the smoothie creamier — no watering down.

name: Nut Butter Rice Cakes
steps: Spread almond butter generously over each rice cake.
Top with banana slices.
Dust with cinnamon and serve.
tip: Rice cakes are the best low-calorie base for toppings — 35 calories each with zero fat.

name: Egg Drop Soup (Egg-Only)
steps: Bring vegetable stock, ginger and soy sauce to a boil.
Dissolve cornstarch in 1 tbsp cold water and stir into stock.
Reduce to a gentle simmer.
Pour whisked eggs in a thin stream while stirring in slow circles.
Remove from heat, drizzle sesame oil and top with spring onion.
tip: Pour eggs very slowly in a thin stream — this creates the signature silky egg ribbons.

name: Lentil & Chickpea Dal Bowl
steps: Cook basmati rice per package.
Sauté onion and garlic in coconut oil 5 minutes.
Add spices, stir 1 minute.
Add rinsed lentils, chickpeas and stock.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils are soft and dal is thick.
Serve over rice.
tip: Combining lentils and chickpeas gives a more complete amino acid profile than either alone.

name: High-Protein Egg Salad
steps: Hard-boil eggs 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Roughly chop eggs.
Mix Greek yogurt, mustard and lemon juice.
Fold in eggs, celery and chives.
Season and serve on bread, crackers or lettuce cups.
tip: Greek yogurt instead of mayo cuts fat by 80% while adding protein and keeping it creamy.
